note: commerce_variation_cart_form adds an 'Add to cart form' pseudo-field (extra field id commerce_variation_cart_form) to Commerce Product Variation displays; when visible it renders a per-variation AddToCartForm. A per-display third-party setting 'combine' (bool, schema core.entity_view_display.*.*.*.third_party.commerce_variation_cart_form) controls whether identical variations merge in the cart. There is no admin settings page (configure=null). This site has the 'default' commerce_product_variation type but NO commerce_order_item types, so all medium/hard cases are grounded on the variation view display commerce_product_variation.default.default: the pseudo-field component visibility + the combine third-party setting, read/written via the entity_display.repository. Facts grounded in commerce_variation_cart_form.module (entity_extra_field_info, hook_commerce_product_variation_view, the combine third-party setting) and README.

evals.prompt: I installed commerce_variation_cart_form on my Drupal Commerce site but nothing changed. How do I actually make the per-variation add-to-cart form appear for a product variation type?
evals.expected_output: It adds an 'Add to cart form' pseudo-field (id commerce_variation_cart_form) to the Product Variation Type's Manage display, hidden by default. Go to Commerce > Configuration > Product Variation Types > Manage display and set that field to visible (then typically render the product's Variations field as a rendered entity).

evals.prompt: In commerce_variation_cart_form, there's an option about combining order items for the same variation. What is it, and where/how is that setting stored?
evals.expected_output: It's the 'Combine order items containing the same product variation' checkbox on the variation display-edit form. When on, adding a variation merges with an identical existing cart line. It's stored as a third-party setting on the entity_view_display: third_party_settings.commerce_variation_cart_form.combine (boolean).

evals.prompt: How do I control which fields (e.g. the Quantity field) appear in the add-to-cart form that commerce_variation_cart_form renders for a variation?
evals.expected_output: The form uses the 'Variation Cart Form' form mode (variation_cart_form) on the Commerce Order Item Type. Go to Commerce > Configuration > Order Item Types > Manage form display, pick the Variation Cart Form mode, and show only Quantity (or hide everything for a bare Add to cart button with default quantity 1).

evals.prompt: On this Commerce site the per-variation add-to-cart form (commerce_variation_cart_form) has been enabled on the default product variation type's default display. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me whether identical variations are set to be combined into one cart line.
evals.expected_output: Yes — combining is enabled: on core.entity_view_display.commerce_product_variation.default.default the commerce_variation_cart_form component's third_party_settings.commerce_variation_cart_form.combine is TRUE.

evals.prompt: The default product variation type on this site shows the commerce_variation_cart_form add-to-cart form. Inspect the live display config and tell me the value of its 'combine' setting.
evals.expected_output: combine is FALSE: on core.entity_view_display.commerce_product_variation.default.default the commerce_variation_cart_form third-party setting 'combine' is set to false, so identical variations are added as separate cart lines.

evals.prompt: On this Commerce site, use commerce_variation_cart_form to show the per-variation add-to-cart form on the DEFAULT product variation type's default view display, and enable the option to combine order items for the same variation. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: core.entity_view_display.commerce_product_variation.default.default has the commerce_variation_cart_form component visible AND its third_party_settings.commerce_variation_cart_form.combine === true.

evals.prompt: On my shop I want an Add to cart button to show on every product variation of my default variation type. But if a customer adds the same variation twice, I want it to appear as two separate lines in the cart, not merged into one. Set that up on the live site.
evals.expected_output: core.entity_view_display.commerce_product_variation.default.default shows the commerce_variation_cart_form component AND its 'combine' setting is NOT enabled (false or unset), so identical variations stay as separate cart lines.
